blacklistabilityReview.evidence: FreezeWatch re-review 2026-10-19. Materiality: the census supply split is Solana 62.2147%, Polygon 23.8861%, Ethereum 8.7163%, Base 4.3641% and the remaining chains under 0.3% each; Solana and Polygon are material. Solana mint DBAzBUXaLj1qANCseUPZz4sp9F8d2sc78C4vKjhbTGMA (Tokenkeg, 9 decimals) at slot 458730488 carries freezeAuthority 3mdd4X7wJjWmhF99jfTNGmSr39EXSAXcdEiS47GejduH, which is non-zero and not renounced (mintAuthority 8Dn2V6HX6gTwkCid2MUiv3mXvMkTcyxQeqTychdBRBSj; supply 9,351,252.717502774), so the authority can freeze any holder's token account. Polygon SBC 0xfdcc3dd6671eab0709a4c0f3f53de9a333d80798 (ERC1967 proxy, implementation 0xcab3f6cd6a2786cc8b2018224f48437a27506e35) enforces an AccessControl deny list at block 95790212: role 0x122c3c5f9caf2fe2940018f2188acecda5c38f4da0bc5e215c7a38055432bb6a has 213 RoleGranted members, including OFAC-listed 0x12d66f87a04a9e220743712ce6d9bb1b5616b8fc, and an eth_call transfer(0x…01,0) from that address reverts with 'AccessControl: account 0x12d66f87… does not have controlled access via role 0x122c…' while the same call from 0x…dEaD returns true. Both material deployments therefore carry active holder-targeted controls: reviewedStatus is true. The Ethereum deployment (8.7163%, proxy implementation 0x87603e4388c13a86d5c2c62431ece3e5f8185af5, unverified) is sub-threshold and does not set the verdict.

nativeExternalTransferReviews.rationale: Brale's March 20, 2025 announcement names SBC, native OFT mint/burn, LayerZero DVN message validation and Ethereum support. The existing pinned Ethereum adapter/token linkage identifies the native SBC deployment. This review establishes the separate external-validation transfer tier, not wrapped issuance or an exhaustive chain census. Effective peers, configured DVN quorum, rate-limit amounts, upgrades, administrator reach and signing topology are not established by this announcement and remain unresolved; native issuer mint controls are not duplicated.
